agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The special meeting of the Boulder City Council was called to order at 8:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION PROVIDING DIRECTION ON THE AREA III – PLANNING RESERVE AS PART OF THE 2010 MAJOR UPDATE TO THE BOULDER VALLEY COMPREHENSIVE PLAN. - 8:00 P.M.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council Member Becker moved, seconded to Council Member Gray to: a) approve Option 2 as outlined in the memo to undertake revisions to the Service Area Expansion Process and part of the 2010 Major Update to the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan, and b) postpone consideration of a Service Area Expansion until after the 2010 Major Update is completed.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:10 P.M.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Becker moved, seconded to Council Member Gray to: a) approve Option 2 as outlined in the memo to undertake revisions to the Service Area Expansion Process and part of the 2010 Major Update to the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan, and b) postpone consideration of a Service Area Expansion until after the 2010 Major Update is completed.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:10 P.M.
motions.vote_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:10 P.M.

open_comment_speakers.name: Sally Dettetre
open_comment_speakers.topic: read a letter by Tom Metz, one of the three owners of the St. Julien supporting Dr. Allan Villavicencio’s proposal for a Boulder Multisport Training & Sports Science Center (BMT), noting that this should be considered as a high priority by City Council and a tremendous value to the community.

open_comment_speakers.name: James Richey
open_comment_speakers.topic: the swim coach of Boulder Swimming spoke to the impacts of all the closed pools in Boulder and the importance of supporting the sports. He also noted the positive reputation for promoting professional sports that will only be enhanced by such a facility.

open_comment_speakers.name: Bruce Wilson
open_comment_speakers.topic: in support of the proposed Multisports Complex, agreed with previous speakers regarding the valuable service this type of facility would be for the whole community.

open_comment_speakers.name: Johnathan Smolens
open_comment_speakers.topic: representing Boulder Eco Village, a group of people who are interested in using the property under discussion to develop Agriburbia.

open_comment_speakers.name: Quint Redmond
open_comment_speakers.topic: TSR group out of Golden who developed the Agraburbia technology. Development of this technology will be a critical element in how future food production will exist.

open_comment_speakers.name: James Harrington
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke of a friend who lived the proposal area and expressed concern regarding impacts to the people who live in the area need to be considered and they need to be included in the process.

open_comment_speakers.name: Jane Scott
open_comment_speakers.topic: head coach for the Boulder Aquatic Masters. Spoke of the support from that group for the Multisports Complex.

open_comment_speakers.name: Dr. Alan Villavicencio
open_comment_speakers.topic: pooled time for 5 minutes. He is the party that submitted the proposal for BMT a Multisports Complex. He encouraged Council not to place this on the back burner as it was completely funded by him and he expressed concern regarding the potential of a missed opportunity. Has also noted that this was not just about world class athletes it was more about solidifying the Boulder Brand and about the Boulder community. He also clarified that CU is very interested in such a facility but they do not have the land to do it.

open_comment_speakers.name: Dawn Elder
open_comment_speakers.topic: mother of three from Texas who comes to Boulder every two months to train. As a tri-athlete she was surprised by the poor quality of facilities for athletes to train. Felt the project had a sense of urgency to take advantage of this proposal.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rakesh Ganeriwala
open_comment_speakers.topic: A Multisports Complex facility would have far reaching effects beyond Boulder. The complex would support the Council’s Smart Energy Goals and would provide for surrounding areas as well from those who would come to train.

open_comment_speakers.name: Susan Peterson
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke in opposition to the proposal expressing the type of proposal being presented to the Council was exactly what the current procedure was intended to prevent.

open_comment_speakers.name: Scott Berryman
open_comment_speakers.topic: a former elite athlete who now works with Denver to support opportunities for kids in need, expressed the benefits of reaching out to create healthy life styles for the kids in Boulder.
